fact_previews: Social Boom Wi-Fi is a project developed by Georgy.
The project aims to help businesses grow, market, and advertise themselves efficiently.
Social Boom Wi-Fi allows visitors to advertise a company's promotions on social media when they connect to Wi-Fi.
The system collects information about the audience through their social media profiles.
Collected data includes visitors' age, gender, date of birth, phone, and email.

Users can plan as many advertisements as they like with Social Boom WiFi.
Social Boom WiFi can generate up to 10,000 views daily.
Social Boom WiFi enables gathering customer reviews through WiFi.
Social Boom WiFi offers easy customization and creation of surveys.
